cuts.head: tilt
cuts.ofreeRecent: a Han-era inn — holds her keepsake at chest height; an indoor lap pool with lane ropes — swimming breaststroke; a quiet seaside tide pool bordered by smooth volcanic rock — catching a small white sunhat that has floated within reach after a light breeze; a sheltered picnic pavilion beside an ancient hillside plum orchard in clear spring daylight — laughing quietly after folding her plain white lunch napkin into a small bird; a night river covered with floating paper lanterns — holds her keepsake at chest height; her living room with a deep sofa — standing; her private chamber in a Han-era residence — standing; the Zhuge Liang shrine on the Wuzhang Plains plateau — standing; a restored wooden plank road bolted to a sheer cliff in Sichuan — lying on her left side; a castle kitchen with a great hearth — lifts a small storage box onto the shelf above her; a sunny beach with wet sand and shallow surf — chest-deep in the water; a chandelier ballroom at a masquerade — holds her keepsake up beside her face; the driver's seat of a small car parked on a quiet street — carries a camera by its grip at her side
